note: Official counting stats. Pitch tracking is not published at this level, so the Statcast and model columns are not on this page.

metrics.label: G (with a PA)
metrics.desc: Games with a plate appearance (defensive replacements and pinch runners without a PA are not counted).

metrics.label: AB
metrics.desc: At-bats: PA minus walks, HBP, sacrifices and catcher's interference.

metrics.label: uBB
metrics.desc: Unintentional walks (MLB's BB includes IBB: add the IBB column).

metrics.label: OBP
metrics.desc: (H + BB + IBB + HBP) / (AB + BB + IBB + HBP + SF).

metrics.label: wOBA
metrics.desc: Savant's woba_value summed over woba_denom: linear weights of each PA result, scaled to OBP.
